{"type":"text","timestamp":1794693688419,"sessionID":"ses_e23ef6c13ffeCgU3kaZuq7crQC","part":{"id":"prt_1dc14682a001LcNL95XJ6cVFIP","messageID":"msg_1dc144906001lZrZtl1FZxjRaZ","sessionID":"ses_e23ef6c13ffeCgU3kaZuq7crQC","type":"text","text":"The shift is over with all four edge services at 0% errors; four faults were found and mitigated, and no mitigation was applied to a service that did not need it.\n\n| Fault | Symptom | Cause | Mitigation |\n| --- | --- | --- | --- |\n| `ranking-svc` overload | `partner-api` ~99% errors from minute -22 | Traffic rose about 2.5x with no change on the service, then a retry storm held it at 86% errors | Scaled 4 → 16 to break the storm, later trimmed to 11 |\n| `catalog-db` bad deploy v67 | `mobile-api` steady 4% errors via `shipping-svc` | Rate-limiter refill divided by 1000, so callers got 429s | Scaled 3 → 6 first, then rolled back; fixed by minute 45 |\n| `push-svc` leaking deploy v25 | `partner-api` still ~92% after the ranking fix | Memory grew steadily from the deploy at -115 to OOM restarts, plus a retry storm | Rolled back with a temporary 70% throttle; fixed by minute 52 |\n| `identity-svc` bad deploy v86 (new at minute 60) | `partner-api` 52% rising to 90% | Key expiry computed as `ttl_s // 600` | Rolled back with a 70% throttle; fixed by minute 83 |\n\n- **`catalog-db` pre-scale:** it was at 0.87 CPU with callers retrying three times, so a rollback failing 30% of requests would have tipped it into a lasting retry storm on the $18,300/min path. The rollback itself still cost about six minutes of 30% errors on `mobile-api`.\n- **`identity-svc` took two attempts:** I lifted the throttle the minute the rollback finished, and leftover retries re-triggered the storm at about 50% errors for two minutes. A second one-minute throttle cleared it.\n- **`push-svc` diff:** the v25 diff looked harmless (a query change and an `httpx` bump), so I rolled it back on the timing of the memory growth rather than on the diff. Memory dropped from 0.99 to 0.44 afterwards.\n- **Left alone:** `sms-svc` had a CPU alert but no edge service depends on it, and the `catalog-db` and `identity-svc` config changes made at the same minute as the bad deploys were not the cause.\n\nExtra replicas still running at the end: `ranking-svc` at 11 (normal 4), which the higher traffic needs, plus `catalog-db` at 4 (normal 3) and `shipping-svc` at 10 (normal 8). The last two are headroom I added as insurance on the `mobile-api` path, at about $9/min together.","time":{"start":1794693687338,"end":1794693688416}}}
